About the Project

Cambridge’s BBSRC biosciences programme offers doctoral training in biological sciences and related quantitative research. Admission and funding conditions are set by the programme.

Research Areas

  • Biosciences and quantitative biology

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull tuition and stipend; the supplied guide states visa/IHS coverage, which should be reconfirmed in current funding terms.
MaintenanceUKRI-linked stipend; GBP 21,805/year is the supplied 2026/27 reference
DurationNormally 4 years; check programme terms

Eligibility and Requirements

Programme academic requirements and bioscience research preparation; International funding is limited. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 course recruitment advertised
Deadline8 December 2026, including references

How to Apply

Apply for Cambridge’s BBSRC biosciences doctoral course with transcripts, CV, two references and the requested research/motivation responses.

The official course application page confirms the 2027 deadline. The programme funding page was inaccessible during this check, so visa/IHS and place allocations require confirmation.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge offers research degrees across a wide range of subjects. Doctoral applicants apply through its postgraduate portal and may be considered for university, college and partner funding.

Official details: Programme information

Application route: Application form or official instructions

2026/27 UKRI reference rate: the minimum UKRI doctoral stipend is £21,805 per year, tax-free (London institutions +£2,000), effective 1 October 2026.
